summary:
Implemented set_window_title across the repo, without running tests or repository code and without committing.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last ControlType member; added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which returns cls((ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title)).
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside set_alt_screen. It checks only is_terminal, buffers Control.title(title) and returns True, or returns False with nothing written. Google-style docstring includes the restore/overwrite caveat.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added one elif branch in the legacy dispatch that calls term.set_title(title) for each title control. The Win32 wrapper is unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: created an Added section under Unreleased, above Fixed, with one bullet linking PR 2200.

Tests added:
- tests/test_console.py::test_set_window_title (skips the assertion on legacy Windows).
- tests/test_control.py::test_control_title.
- tests/test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only via the module's existing skip).

Not verified: mypy and Black were not run. Test results are unknown since tests were not executed.
